property_summary: If transfer returns (i.e. does not revert) then it returns true and it must have been called by C.from; additionally, when called successfully the function returns true and callers other than C.from must cause a revert.
If c.transfer does not revert when called from this test contract, then it returns true and address(this) equals c.from() (i.e., only the designated from address can successfully call transfer).
If c.transfer returns (doesn't revert) when called from this test, it returns true and the input arrays are non-empty and had equal length as required by the contract.
For any non-empty arrays of equal length, when c.transfer is called from this test it either reverts or returns true (i.e., it never returns false).
